name: Odyssian Blaze
source:
The mother Goddesses never imagined her divine children would plunge humanity into chaos. On her knees, she begs her son Zeus to help her.

Pick your chosen avatar and embark for a real odyssey fielded with legend and mysteries. Unite with gods, and emerge triumphant from the celestial trials of the Olympus.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/odyssianblaze/odyssian-blaze-visual-novel-adventure-dating-sim/description]Kickstarter[/url]]

Odyssian Blaze is a "free to pay" that requires "Chronos", a currency, to progress in the visual novel. You get free Chronos when logging in or pay for them.
translation:
母神们从未想到她的神圣孩子们会让人类陷入混乱。她跪下请求儿子宙斯帮助她。

选择你所选择的化身，踏上充满传奇和神秘的真正奥德赛之旅。与诸神联合，从奥林匹斯的天界考验中获得胜利。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/odyssianblaze/odyssian-blaze-visual-novel-adventure-dating-sim/description]Kickstarter[/url]]

Odyssian Blaze是一款“免费付费”游戏，需要货币“Chronos”才能在视觉小说中取得进展。登录或付费后你将获得免费的Chronos。
